title: GitHub - twalichiewicz/HNewhere: A lightweight userscript that adds Hacker News discussions to any previously submitted article.
excerpt: A lightweight userscript that adds Hacker News discussions to any previously submitted article. - twalichiewicz/HNewhere
content_html:
A lightweight userscript that adds Hacker News discussions to any article.

HNewhere detects matching Hacker News stories, loads comments into a sidebar, and lets you browse discussions without leaving the page.

Install

  1. Install a userscript manager:

    • Tampermonkey
    • Violentmonkey
    • Userscripts (Safari)

  2. Install HNewhere

  3. Visit an article with a Hacker News discussion.

Features

  • Automatically detects Hacker News discussions for articles
  • Displays HN comments in a sidebar without leaving the page
  • Tracks stories opened from Hacker News
  • Resizable sidebar with saved width
  • Collapsible comment threads with saved state
  • Highlights new comments since your last visit
  • Shows story text when available
  • Marks original poster comments
  • Reply links open directly to Hacker News

Requirements

  • A browser with userscript support
  • Access to:
    • Hacker News API
    • HN Algolia search API

License

MIT

一个轻量级用户脚本，可将黑客新闻讨论添加到任何文章中。

HNewhere 检测匹配的黑客新闻故事，将评论加载到侧边栏中，并让您无需离开页面即可浏览讨论。

安装

  1. 安装用户脚本管理器：Tampermonkey Violentmonkey Userscripts (Safari)
  2. 安装 HNewhere
  3. 访问一篇包含黑客新闻讨论的文章。

特征

  • 自动检测文章的黑客新闻讨论
  • 在侧边栏中显示 HN 评论，无需离开页面
  • 跟踪从 Hacker News 打开的故事
  • 可调整大小的侧边栏并保存宽度
  • 具有保存状态的可折叠评论线程
  • 突出显示自您上次访问以来的新评论
  • 显示可用的故事文本
  • 标记原帖评论
  • 回复链接可直接打开黑客新闻

要求

  • 支持用户脚本的浏览器
  • 访问：Hacker News API HN Algolia 搜索 API

MIT
